Dividend amounts are declared at AIA's discretion.

trends.whatProductOffers: Premiums are guaranteed to stay fixed throughout the chosen premium payment term, with five terms available: one-time, 5, 10, 18 and 25 years.
exclusionsOrConditions: The premium is fixed only during the premium payment term; the policy remains in force after payments end.
Issue age limits differ by payment term, from 15 days–75 for single premium down to 15 days–55 for 25-year terms.
Add-on plan premiums are separate and not fixed by the basic plan.
